title: The Slow Blue Hour
author: Jonah Okonkwo
blurb: Emrys Blackwood, a former prodigy returning to the conservatory as a janitor, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
